title: RuntimeSession.apply_event result
description: APPLIED: the state changed. DUPLICATE: it already was as the event asks (judged by content), or the same event id arrived again with the same payload (reason event_id_replayed; the recorded result is returned). REJECTED: a rule refused it and nothing changed. ERROR: the backend failed and the event's transaction rolled back. The same event id with another payload is an operation error (event_id_conflict).
